    mid = len(ordered) // 2
    if len(ordered) % 2 == 0:
        return (ordered[mid - 1] + ordered[mid]) / 2
    return ordered[mid]

def mean(values: list[float]) -> float:
    if not values:
        raise ValueError("average of an empty list")
    total = 0.0
    for v in values:
        total += v
    result = total / len(values)
    rounded = round(result * 100) / 100
    return rounded
